description: Time picker wrapping TmTimeInput with label, placeholder, clear button, and validation styling for out-of-range values.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the nested TmTimeInput read-only. Never assigned inside the picker. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: HourCycle
parameters.description: 12-hour versus 24-hour clock forwarded to TmTimeInput. Default Auto follows Culture.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve HourCycle.Auto. Null uses CurrentCulture.

examples.title: Time picker with seconds and constraints
examples.code:
<TmTimePicker @bind-Value="selectedTime"
              Label="Alarm"
              ShowSeconds="true"
              MinTime="@(new TimeOnly(6, 0))"
              MaxTime="@(new TimeOnly(22, 0))" />
